WITH PatientAverages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALP IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0
                 THEN 1.0 * l.ALP / l.GPT END) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS excluded
        WHERE excluded.ID = p.ID
          AND excluded.`U-PRO` = '-'
    )
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt,
    AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS average_alp_gpt_ratio
FROM PatientAverages
GROUP BY SEX
